summary: Super Group (SGHC) Limited filed a Form 6-K on August 4, 2026, containing a press release with unaudited financial results for Q2 2026. The filing reports record revenue of $684 million (up 18% YoY), profit of $123 million, adjusted EBITDA of $204 million (up 30%), and cash of $548 million. The company raised full-year 2026 guidance to over $2.6 billion revenue and $710 million adjusted EBITDA. No special-situation corporate event such as a merger, tender offer, or spin-off is mentioned. This is a routine earnings announcement, thus not classified as a special situation.
